target_set_definition: Cases are labelled by USER INTENT (`intent`), never by whether the message contains a number or a trigger keyword. T11/T13/T15 contain numbers but must NOT trigger; T02/T08 contain no number but MUST trigger. `should_trigger` is a human judgement against the When-to-use / When-not-to-use sections of SKILL.md.
label_source: Hand-written from realistic AI-PM requests. No private data.
why_a_baseline: Trigger precision is the second axis of skill quality. A deterministic intent-hint baseline is the control group; real model triggering is scored with scripts/eval_extras.py --suite trigger --predictions <file>. This repo does not fabricate that score.
